anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sheet (display.kicad_sch), U4 pin 28 (named VCC) is wired directly into the left-hand GND cluster together with VSS(8) and VLSS(29). The 2.2 µF bypass capacitor C7 is instead hung on pin 9 (VDD), which is the pin tied to the VCC rail.
anomalies.expected: The specification designates U4's VCC pin as the digital-logic supply and places C7 across it: 'C7 (2.2 µF) — U4 VCC (digital-logic supply pin) to GND', and 'U4's VBAT pin ... is tied directly to the board's main VCC net'. The VCC pin must therefore sit on the VCC rail (with C7 as its local bypass to GND), not be shorted to GND.

evidence.quote: display.kicad_sch: U4 pin '28 VCC' wire joins the GND symbol alongside '8 VSS' and '29 VLSS'; 'C7 2.2u' top plate connects to the VDD(9)/VCC-rail node, not to pin 28

anomalies.impact: The OLED driver's supply pin is shorted to ground, so the SSD1306 logic/charge-pump supply is dead; the display will not power up and the VCC rail sees a hard short through the driver, likely causing over-current and no display output.

parsed.summary: All passive values, pull-up networks, I2C/SSD1306 strapping, NFC antenna and TSC wiring match the specification, but on the display sheet U4's VCC pin (28) is tied straight to GND while C7 is placed on VDD, contradicting the spec's statement that U4 VCC is the digital-logic supply bypassed by C7 — a short-to-ground of the OLED supply pin.
